title: Kangaroo and Cage
simplified_paragraphs: 一天，有人发现袋鼠从笼子里跑出来了。大家经过讨论认为，是因为笼子太低了，所以他们决定把笼子的高度从10米加高到20米。结果第二天，他们发现袋鼠还是跑到了外面，所以他们又决定把高度加高到30米。但是加高后，他们居然又看到袋鼠跑到了外面，于是他们决定把笼子的高度加高到100米，他们觉得这样袋鼠一定跑不出去了。
长颈鹿看到了，问袋鼠：“你们觉得这些人会不会继续加高你们的笼子？”袋鼠说∶“很难说，如果他们再继续忘记关门，我们还是会跑出去，他们可能就会继续加高笼子！”
traditional_paragraphs: 一天，有人發現袋鼠從籠子裡跑出來了。大家經過討論認為，是因為籠子太低了，所以他們決定把籠子的高度從10米加高到20米。結果第二天，他們發現袋鼠還是跑到了外面，所以他們又決定把高度加高到30米。但是加高後，他們居然又看到袋鼠跑到了外面，於是他們決定把籠子的高度加高到100米，他們覺得這樣袋鼠一定跑不出去了。
長頸鹿看到了，問袋鼠：“你們覺得這些人會不會繼續加高你們的籠子？”袋鼠說∶“很難說，如果他們再繼續忘記關門，我們還是會跑出去，他們可能就會繼續加高籠子！”
pinyin_paragraphs: yī tiān， yǒu rén fā xiàn dài shǔ cóng lóng zi lǐ pǎo chū lái le。 dà jiā jīng guò tǎo lùn rèn wéi， shì yīn wèi lóng zi tài dī le， suǒ yǐ tā men jué dìng bǎ lóng zi de gāo dù cóng 10 mǐ jiā gāo dào 20 mǐ。 jié guǒ dì èr tiān， tā men fā xiàn dài shǔ hái shi pǎo dào le wài miàn， suǒ yǐ tā men yòu jué dìng bǎ gāo dù jiā gāo dào 30 mǐ。 dàn shì jiā gāo hòu， tā men jū rán yòu kàn dào dài shǔ pǎo dào le wài miàn， yú shì tā men jué dìng bǎ lóng zi de gāo dù jiā gāo dào 100 mǐ， tā men jué de zhè yàng dài shǔ yī dìng pǎo bù chū qù le。

cháng jǐng lù kàn dào le， wèn dài shǔ：“ nǐ men jué de zhè xiē rén huì bù huì jì xù jiā gāo nǐ men de lóng zi？” dài shǔ shuō ∶“ hěn nán shuō， rú guǒ tā men zài jì xù wàng jì guān mén， wǒ men hái shi huì pǎo chū qù， tā men kě néng jiù huì jì xù jiā gāo lóng zi！”
english_paragraphs: One day, someone discovered that the kangaroos had gotten out of their enclosure. After discussing it, everyone decided the fence was too low, so they raised it from 10 meters to 20 meters. But the next day, they found the kangaroos outside again, so they raised it to 30 meters. Even after that, the kangaroos still got out. Finally, they decided to make the fence 100 meters high, certain the kangaroos would never escape.

A giraffe saw what was happening and asked the kangaroos, “Do you think these people will keep raising the fence around your enclosure?” The kangaroos replied, “Hard to say. If they keep forgetting to close the gate, we’ll keep getting out, and they might just keep raising the fence!”
english_full:
One day, someone discovered that the kangaroos had gotten out of their enclosure. After discussing it, everyone decided the fence was too low, so they raised it from 10 meters to 20 meters. But the next day, they found the kangaroos outside again, so they raised it to 30 meters. Even after that, the kangaroos still got out. Finally, they decided to make the fence 100 meters high, certain the kangaroos would never escape.

A giraffe saw what was happening and asked the kangaroos, “Do you think these people will keep raising the fence around your enclosure?” The kangaroos replied, “Hard to say. If they keep forgetting to close the gate, we’ll keep getting out, and they might just keep raising the fence!”
